subject: Ondo TokenProxy (OpenZeppelin TransparentUpgradeableProxy, solc 0.8.16)

reviewedFunctions.name: upgradeTo
reviewedFunctions.source: function upgradeTo(address newImplementation) external ifAdmin { _upgradeToAndCall(newImplementation, bytes(""), false); }
reviewedFunctions.finding: external ifAdmin; body is _upgradeToAndCall(newImplementation, "", false), so no delegatecall follows. For the admin this replaces the implementation inside the proxy itself.

reviewedFunctions.name: ifAdmin
reviewedFunctions.finding: Runs the function body only when msg.sender equals _getAdmin(); every other caller is delegated to the implementation.

reviewedFunctions.name: _getAdmin
reviewedFunctions.finding: Reads the admin from _ADMIN_SLOT, which is the EIP-1967 admin slot the producer reads.

reviewedFunctions.name: _upgradeToAndCall
reviewedFunctions.source: function _upgradeToAndCall( address newImplementation, bytes memory data, bool forceCall ) internal { _upgradeTo(newImplementation); if (data.length > 0 || forceCall) { Address.functionDelegateCall(newImplementation, data); } }
reviewedFunctions.finding: Calls _upgradeTo(newImplementation); delegatecalls the new implementation only when data is non-empty or forceCall is true.

reviewedFunctions.name: _upgradeTo
reviewedFunctions.finding: Calls _setImplementation(newImplementation) and emits Upgraded; no other condition.

reviewedFunctions.name: _setImplementation
reviewedFunctions.source: function _setImplementation(address newImplementation) private { require( Address.isContract(newImplementation), "ERC1967: new implementation is not a contract" ); StorageSlot.getAddressSlot(_IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).value = newImplementation; }
reviewedFunctions.finding: Requires the new implementation to be a contract, then stores it in _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT: the EIP-1967 implementation slot is overwritten.

conclusion: For this exact proxy runtime code, upgradeTo called by the address in the EIP-1967 admin slot is executed by the proxy itself (it is never delegated) and overwrites the EIP-1967 implementation slot with the supplied contract address. The admin therefore controls which code the proxy runs.
limits: Source-to-bytecode identity is Sourcify exact_match (creation and runtime, no transformations) for this code hash; it was not recompiled locally.
The review covers the proxy code only. It says nothing about who controls the admin address (multisig, governance, timelock) or about delays before an upgrade can execute.
It does not review the implementation and proves no mint capability.
